name: Default
shortDescription: Vector observability data pipeline receiving newline-delimited JSON events on a bearer-token protected HTTPS endpoint, with an editable vector.yaml to transform and route them to sinks.

alerts.message: Out of the box Vector only prints received events to its container logs. Edit vector.yaml to add a real sink such as Loki, Elasticsearch or S3. Clients must send the generated ingest_token as an Authorization: Bearer header.
